exercises.title: Push-up
exercises.excerpt: The best no-equipment chest builder. Scale it from wall to floor as you get stronger.

steps.title: Set your hands
steps.text: Hands slightly wider than shoulders, fingers spread, wrists under shoulders.

steps.title: Make a plank
steps.text: Squeeze glutes and brace your stomach so your body is one straight line from head to heels.

steps.title: Lower with control
steps.text: Bend the elbows to about 45 degrees from your body until your chest is a fist above the floor.

steps.title: Press the floor away
steps.text: Push back up without letting your hips sag or lead.

mistakes.title: Hips sagging
mistakes.fix: Squeeze your glutes and shorten the set until you can hold the line.

mistakes.title: Elbows flared wide
mistakes.fix: Tuck them to roughly 45 degrees to protect the shoulders.

mistakes.title: Half reps
mistakes.fix: Raise your hands on a bench and use full range instead.

exercises.title: Bodyweight squat
exercises.excerpt: Learn the squat pattern before you load it. Works anywhere, including a small flat.

steps.title: Stance
steps.text: Feet about shoulder width apart, toes turned out slightly.

steps.title: Brace
steps.text: Breathe in, tighten your stomach and keep your chest proud.

steps.title: Sit down and back
steps.text: Push hips back and let knees travel out over your toes.

steps.title: Stand tall
steps.text: Drive through the whole foot and finish with hips fully straight.

mistakes.title: Knees caving in
mistakes.fix: Push your knees out in line with your toes.

mistakes.title: Heels lifting
mistakes.fix: Keep weight mid-foot; a slightly wider stance helps.

exercises.title: Glute bridge
exercises.excerpt: A gentle way to wake up the glutes, good for beginners and desk workers.

steps.title: Lie down
steps.text: On your back, knees bent, feet flat and hip-width apart near your glutes.

steps.title: Brace
steps.text: Flatten your lower back lightly into the floor.

steps.title: Drive up
steps.text: Push through your heels and lift hips until shoulders, hips and knees line up.

steps.title: Squeeze and lower
steps.text: Pause one second at the top, then lower slowly.

mistakes.title: Arching the lower back
mistakes.fix: Stop when hips are straight; the squeeze comes from the glutes, not the spine.

mistakes.title: Feet too far away
mistakes.fix: Bring them closer so you feel glutes, not hamstrings cramping.

exercises.title: Plank
exercises.excerpt: Trains your core to keep the spine still, which carries over to every big lift.

steps.title: Forearms down
steps.text: Elbows under shoulders, forearms parallel.

steps.title: Step back
steps.text: Legs straight, feet hip-width apart.

steps.title: Lock in
steps.text: Squeeze glutes, tuck the pelvis slightly and brace like you expect a punch.

steps.title: Breathe and hold
steps.text: Keep breathing. Stop the set when your form slips, not when the timer says.

mistakes.title: Hips too high or low
mistakes.fix: Ask someone to check, or film yourself from the side.

mistakes.title: Holding your breath
mistakes.fix: Take short breaths while keeping the brace.

exercises.title: Goblet squat
exercises.excerpt: The easiest loaded squat to learn. The weight in front helps you stay upright.

steps.title: Hold the weight
steps.text: Cup one dumbbell at chest height, elbows pointing down.

steps.title: Stance
steps.text: Feet a little wider than shoulders, toes slightly out.

steps.title: Squat between your legs
steps.text: Sit down until elbows brush the inside of your knees, chest up.

steps.title: Drive up
steps.text: Push the floor away and stand fully.

mistakes.title: Dumbbell drifting forward
mistakes.fix: Keep it touching your chest the whole rep.

mistakes.title: Rounding at the bottom
mistakes.fix: Only go as deep as you can with a flat back.

exercises.title: Dumbbell bent-over row
exercises.excerpt: Builds a stronger, thicker back with just a pair of dumbbells.

steps.title: Hinge
steps.text: Soft knees, push hips back until your torso is about 45 degrees, back flat.

steps.title: Let the weights hang
steps.text: Arms straight under your shoulders, palms facing each other.

steps.title: Row to your hips
steps.text: Pull elbows back toward your hip pockets, squeezing shoulder blades together.

steps.title: Lower slowly
steps.text: Take two seconds to return to straight arms.

mistakes.title: Jerking the weight
mistakes.fix: Go lighter and pause for a second at the top.

mistakes.title: Rounded back
mistakes.fix: Keep your chest up and brace before every rep.

exercises.title: Dumbbell shoulder press
exercises.excerpt: A simple overhead press for stronger, healthier shoulders.

steps.title: Start position
steps.text: Sit or stand tall, dumbbells at shoulder height, palms forward or slightly in.

steps.title: Brace
steps.text: Tighten your stomach and glutes so your lower back stays neutral.

steps.title: Press up
steps.text: Push the weights up until arms are straight, biceps near your ears.

steps.title: Lower to the shoulders
steps.text: Bring them back down with control.

mistakes.title: Leaning back
mistakes.fix: Squeeze glutes; if you still lean, the weight is too heavy.

mistakes.title: Partial range
mistakes.fix: Lower to at least chin level each rep.

exercises.title: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
exercises.excerpt: Teaches the hip hinge and builds the hamstrings and glutes.

steps.title: Stand tall
steps.text: Dumbbells in front of your thighs, feet hip-width, soft knees.

steps.title: Push hips back
steps.text: Slide the weights down your legs as your hips move back, back flat.

steps.title: Feel the stretch
steps.text: Stop when you feel a strong hamstring stretch, usually around mid-shin.

steps.title: Drive hips forward
steps.text: Squeeze glutes to stand up; do not lean back at the top.

mistakes.title: Squatting instead of hinging
mistakes.fix: Keep the knee bend small and fixed; the hips do the moving.

mistakes.title: Weights drifting away
mistakes.fix: Keep them brushing your legs the whole time.

exercises.title: Band pull-apart
exercises.excerpt: Cheap, quick and great for posture. Do a few sets between pressing exercises.

steps.title: Grip
steps.text: Hold a light band at shoulder height, arms straight, hands shoulder-width.

steps.title: Set the shoulders
steps.text: Pull shoulders down away from your ears.

steps.title: Pull apart
steps.text: Open your arms out to the sides until the band touches your chest.

steps.title: Return slowly
steps.text: Resist the band on the way back.

mistakes.title: Shrugging
mistakes.fix: Keep shoulders low; use a lighter band.

mistakes.title: Bending the elbows
mistakes.fix: Keep arms nearly straight so the upper back does the work.

exercises.title: Dumbbell biceps curl
exercises.excerpt: The classic arm builder. Strict form beats heavy weight here.

steps.title: Stand tall
steps.text: Dumbbells at your sides, palms facing forward.

steps.title: Pin the elbows
steps.text: Keep elbows by your ribs for the whole set.

steps.title: Curl
steps.text: Bend the elbows and lift until the dumbbells reach shoulder height.

steps.title: Lower all the way
steps.text: Take two seconds to straighten your arms fully.

mistakes.title: Swinging the body
mistakes.fix: Lighten the weight, or sit on a bench to stop the swing.

mistakes.title: Elbows moving forward
mistakes.fix: Keep them still at your sides.

exercises.title: Overhead triceps extension
exercises.excerpt: Trains the long head of the triceps, which makes up most of the back of the arm.

steps.title: Hold one dumbbell
steps.text: Grip one end with both hands and press it straight overhead.

steps.title: Brace
steps.text: Ribs down, glutes tight, so your lower back does not arch.

steps.title: Lower behind your head
steps.text: Bend only the elbows until you feel a stretch in the triceps.

steps.title: Extend
steps.text: Straighten the arms back to the start.

mistakes.title: Elbows flaring out
mistakes.fix: Keep them pointing forward, close to your head.

mistakes.title: Arching the back
mistakes.fix: Sit on a bench with back support.

exercises.title: Barbell back squat
exercises.excerpt: The king of leg exercises. Learn the goblet squat first.

steps.title: Set the bar
steps.text: Rack it at mid-chest height. Rest it on your upper back, not your neck.

steps.title: Brace
steps.text: Feet about shoulder width, toes slightly out. Breathe in and tighten your core.

steps.title: Sit down and back
steps.text: Push hips back and knees out over your toes. Keep your chest up.

steps.title: Drive up
steps.text: Go as deep as you can with a neutral back, then push the floor away to stand.

mistakes.title: Knees caving in
mistakes.fix: Push knees out in line with your toes.

mistakes.title: Heels lifting
mistakes.fix: Keep weight mid-foot and work on ankle mobility.

mistakes.title: Rounding the back
mistakes.fix: Brace harder and lower the weight.

exercises.title: Barbell bench press
exercises.excerpt: The main upper-body strength lift. Always use safety bars or a spotter.

steps.title: Set up
steps.text: Eyes under the bar, feet flat, shoulder blades squeezed together and down.

steps.title: Grip and unrack
steps.text: Hands a little wider than shoulders, wrists straight. Move the bar over your shoulders.

steps.title: Lower to the chest
steps.text: Bring the bar to your lower chest with elbows about 45 to 70 degrees from the body.

steps.title: Press
steps.text: Drive the bar up and slightly back over your shoulders.

mistakes.title: Bouncing off the chest
mistakes.fix: Touch lightly and press; use a lighter weight.

mistakes.title: Elbows flared at 90 degrees
mistakes.fix: Tuck them a little to protect the shoulders.

mistakes.title: Benching alone without safeties
mistakes.fix: Set the rack's safety arms or ask for a spot.

exercises.title: Conventional deadlift
exercises.excerpt: A full-body strength lift. Master the Romanian deadlift before adding heavy weight.

steps.title: Bar over mid-foot
steps.text: Stand with feet hip-width, the bar over the middle of your feet.

steps.title: Grip
steps.text: Hinge down and grab the bar just outside your legs.

steps.title: Set your back
steps.text: Shins to the bar, chest up, pull the slack out of the bar until your back is flat and tight.

steps.title: Push the floor away
steps.text: Stand up with the bar dragging up your legs, then lock hips and knees together.

mistakes.title: Rounded lower back
mistakes.fix: Lower the weight and set your back before every rep.

mistakes.title: Bar drifting forward
mistakes.fix: Keep it in contact with your legs.

mistakes.title: Leaning back at the top
mistakes.fix: Finish by squeezing glutes, standing straight.

exercises.title: Pull-up
exercises.excerpt: The best bodyweight back exercise. Use a band or negatives until you get your first rep.

steps.title: Hang
steps.text: Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders, palms facing away, arms straight.

steps.title: Set the shoulders
steps.text: Pull your shoulders down away from your ears before you bend the arms.

steps.title: Pull
steps.text: Drive elbows down toward your ribs until your chin clears the bar.

steps.title: Lower fully
steps.text: Return to a straight-arm hang with control.

mistakes.title: Kicking and swinging
mistakes.fix: Squeeze legs together and keep the core tight.

mistakes.title: Half reps
mistakes.fix: Use a resistance band to get full-range reps.

exercises.title: Reverse lunge
exercises.excerpt: A knee-friendly lunge that builds balance and single-leg strength.

steps.title: Stand tall
steps.text: Feet hip-width apart, hands on hips or by your sides.

steps.title: Step back
steps.text: Take a long step back and lower until both knees are bent to about 90 degrees.

steps.title: Stay upright
steps.text: Keep your chest up and front knee over the middle of your foot.

steps.title: Drive back up
steps.text: Push through the front heel to return, then switch legs.

mistakes.title: Front knee caving in
mistakes.fix: Push the knee out in line with your toes.

mistakes.title: Short steps
mistakes.fix: Step back far enough that your front shin stays fairly upright.

exercises.title: Dumbbell split squat
exercises.excerpt: A stable single-leg exercise. Easier to balance than a walking lunge.

steps.title: Set the stance
steps.text: Hold dumbbells at your sides and take a long split stance.

steps.title: Lower straight down
steps.text: Bend both knees until the back knee nearly touches the floor.

steps.title: Keep weight forward
steps.text: Most of your weight stays on the front foot.

steps.title: Stand up
steps.text: Push through the front foot. Do all reps, then switch legs.

mistakes.title: Stance too narrow
mistakes.fix: Feet hip-width apart side to side, like standing on train tracks.

mistakes.title: Leaning far forward
mistakes.fix: Keep your torso tall and brace your core.

exercises.title: Dead bug
exercises.excerpt: Teaches your core to keep the lower back still while your limbs move.

steps.title: Set up
steps.text: Lie on your back, arms up to the ceiling, knees bent over hips.

steps.title: Flatten the back
steps.text: Press your lower back gently into the floor.

steps.title: Extend opposite limbs
steps.text: Slowly lower one arm and the opposite leg towards the floor.

steps.title: Return and switch
steps.text: Bring them back and repeat on the other side.

mistakes.title: Lower back arching
mistakes.fix: Make the movement smaller until your back stays down.

mistakes.title: Rushing
mistakes.fix: Move slowly and breathe out as you extend.

exercises.title: Pike push-up
exercises.excerpt: An overhead press using only bodyweight. Raise your feet to make it harder.

steps.title: Make an upside-down V
steps.text: Hands shoulder-width, hips high, head between your arms.

steps.title: Lower your head
steps.text: Bend the elbows and lower the top of your head towards the floor.

steps.title: Keep hips high
steps.text: Your body stays in a V the whole time.

steps.title: Press back up
steps.text: Push through your hands until your arms are straight.

mistakes.title: Turning it into a push-up
mistakes.fix: Keep your hips high so the shoulders do the work.

mistakes.title: Elbows flaring wide
mistakes.fix: Keep them at about 45 degrees.

exercises.title: Band lat pulldown
exercises.excerpt: Trains the same muscles as a pull-up, with a band anchored above you.

steps.title: Anchor the band
steps.text: Loop it over a sturdy door top or bar, above head height.

steps.title: Kneel and grip
steps.text: Kneel facing the anchor, arms straight up holding the band.

steps.title: Pull elbows down
steps.text: Drive your elbows down to your ribs, squeezing the shoulder blades.

steps.title: Return slowly
steps.text: Let your arms rise with control.

mistakes.title: Leaning back a lot
mistakes.fix: Stay upright; a slight lean is fine.

mistakes.title: Pulling with the hands
mistakes.fix: Think about pulling with your elbows.

exercises.title: Band seated row
exercises.excerpt: A cheap, joint-friendly row that works anywhere.

steps.title: Sit tall
steps.text: Legs straight, band looped around your feet.

steps.title: Grip
steps.text: Hold the ends with arms straight, shoulders down.

steps.title: Row
steps.text: Pull your hands to your stomach, elbows close to your body.

steps.title: Return slowly
steps.text: Straighten your arms without rounding forward.

mistakes.title: Rocking backwards
mistakes.fix: Keep your torso still; the arms and back move.

mistakes.title: Shrugging
mistakes.fix: Keep shoulders away from your ears.

exercises.title: Dumbbell floor press
exercises.excerpt: A chest press with no bench. The floor limits the range, which is easier on shoulders.

steps.title: Lie down
steps.text: On your back, knees bent, a dumbbell in each hand over your chest.

steps.title: Lower
steps.text: Bring your elbows down until your upper arms touch the floor.

steps.title: Pause
steps.text: Rest the arms lightly for a moment.

steps.title: Press
steps.text: Push the dumbbells back up over your chest.

mistakes.title: Bouncing elbows off the floor
mistakes.fix: Touch lightly and pause.

mistakes.title: Wrists bent back
mistakes.fix: Keep wrists straight over your elbows.

exercises.title: Barbell overhead press
exercises.excerpt: Builds strong shoulders and a solid core. Start light and learn the bar path.

steps.title: Set up
steps.text: Bar on your front shoulders, hands just outside shoulder width.

steps.title: Brace
steps.text: Squeeze glutes and tighten your stomach.

steps.title: Press
steps.text: Push the bar up, moving your head back slightly so it clears your chin.

steps.title: Lock out
steps.text: Finish with the bar over the middle of your feet, head through.

mistakes.title: Leaning back
mistakes.fix: Squeeze your glutes; lower the weight if you still lean.

mistakes.title: Bar drifting forward
mistakes.fix: Keep it close to your face on the way up.

exercises.title: Barbell bent-over row
exercises.excerpt: A heavy back builder. Learn the hinge with the Romanian deadlift first.

steps.title: Hinge
steps.text: Hold the bar, soft knees, hips back until your torso is about 45 degrees.

steps.title: Brace
steps.text: Flat back, chest up, bar hanging under your shoulders.

steps.title: Row
steps.text: Pull the bar to your lower ribs.

steps.title: Lower with control
steps.text: Straighten your arms without losing your back position.

mistakes.title: Standing up as you row
mistakes.fix: Keep the torso angle fixed.

mistakes.title: Rounded back
mistakes.fix: Use less weight and brace before each rep.

gear.title: Adjustable dumbbells
gear.excerpt: Replace a full rack of dumbbells in a small flat. The single best home-gym buy.

gear.title: Resistance band set
gear.excerpt: Light, cheap and portable. Great for warm-ups, pull-aparts and assisted pull-ups.

gear.title: Doorway pull-up bar
gear.excerpt: Turns any sturdy door frame into a back-training station. Check your frame first.

gear.title: Adjustable flat bench
gear.excerpt: Unlocks presses, rows and step-ups. Look for a stable base and a good weight rating.

gear.title: Squat rack with safety arms
gear.excerpt: Lets you squat and bench heavy, safely, on your own.

gear.title: Olympic barbell and plates
gear.excerpt: The foundation of a full home gym. Rubber plates are kinder to floors and neighbours.

supplements.title: Whey protein
supplements.verdict: Useful if you struggle to reach your protein target from food. It is food, not magic: dal, paneer, curd and eggs work too.
supplements.excerpt: A convenient way to top up protein. Buy only from authorised sellers.

supplements.title: Creatine monohydrate
supplements.verdict: The most researched supplement for strength and muscle. Plain monohydrate is enough; fancy forms cost more for no extra benefit.
supplements.excerpt: Cheap, safe for healthy adults and well studied.

supplements.title: Caffeine
supplements.verdict: Can make hard sessions feel easier. A cup of coffee before training does the job; avoid it late in the day.
supplements.excerpt: Coffee counts. You probably do not need a pre-workout.

supplements.title: BCAAs
supplements.verdict: Not worth it if you eat enough protein, because protein already contains these amino acids.
supplements.excerpt: Mostly flavoured water if your protein intake is good.

supplements.title: Fat burners
supplements.verdict: Skip them. Fat loss comes from a calorie deficit. Many products are mainly caffeine at a high price.
supplements.excerpt: Save the money and spend it on food and gear.

posts.title: A 3-day full-body plan for complete beginners
posts.excerpt: Three sessions a week, six exercises, and a simple rule for when to add weight.
posts.content:
If you are new to training, you do not need a complicated split. Train your whole body three times a week, with a rest day between sessions, and add a little weight or a rep each week.

The plan

When to add weight

When you hit the top of the rep range on every set with good form, go a little heavier next session. Open each exercise in the library to check your form before you start.

posts.title: How to hit your protein on a vegetarian Indian diet
posts.excerpt: Spread protein across the day with foods you already eat. Rough numbers, no powders required.
posts.content:
Most people who train do well on roughly 1.6 to 2 g of protein per kg of body weight a day. Use the macro calculator for your own number, then spread it across three or four meals.

Good vegetarian sources

  • Paneer and tofu
  • Soya chunks
  • Hung curd and Greek-style yogurt
  • Dal, rajma, chole and sprouts
  • Milk, and eggs if you eat them

Check the nutrition label or a food database for exact amounts, because they vary by brand and recipe.

posts.title: How to check if your whey protein is genuine
posts.excerpt: Fake supplements are a real problem. Five checks before you open the tub.
posts.content:
1. Buy from the brand's own site or an authorised seller.
  2. Look for the FSSAI licence number on the label.
  3. Use the brand's authenticity code or QR check if it has one.
  4. Check the seal, batch number and expiry date.
  5. Be wary of prices far below the usual market price.

recipes.title: Moong dal chilla
recipes.excerpt: Savoury lentil pancakes. High protein, no eggs needed.
method: Grind the soaked dal with a little water, chilli and ginger to a thick batter.
Stir in the onion, tomato and salt.
Spread thin on a hot oiled pan and cook both sides until golden.
Serve with green chutney.

recipes.title: Poha with peanuts
recipes.excerpt: A quick, light breakfast. Add sprouts or a side of curd for more protein.
method: Rinse the poha and let it soften for 5 minutes.
Fry peanuts, mustard seeds and curry leaves in oil.
Add onion and peas, then the poha, turmeric and salt.
Finish with lemon juice and coriander.

recipes.title: Masala omelette with toast
recipes.excerpt: Three eggs, vegetables and one slice of toast. Done in ten minutes.
method: Beat the eggs with the vegetables, salt and pepper.
Cook in a hot oiled pan until set, then fold.
Serve with toasted bread.

recipes.title: Overnight oats with curd and banana
recipes.excerpt: Make it the night before. No cooking in the morning.
method: Mix the oats, curd, chia seeds and a splash of milk in a jar.
Refrigerate overnight.
Top with sliced banana before eating.

recipes.title: Rajma chawal
recipes.excerpt: Kidney bean curry with rice. Comfort food with good fibre and plant protein.
method: Cook the onion-tomato masala with ginger, garlic and spices.
Add the cooked rajma with some of its water and simmer 15 minutes.
Mash a few beans to thicken the gravy.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Paneer bhurji with roti
recipes.excerpt: Scrambled paneer with vegetables. One of the easiest high-protein veg meals.
method: Sauté onion and capsicum, then add tomato and spices.
Stir in the crumbled paneer and cook 3 to 4 minutes.
Finish with coriander and serve with rotis.

recipes.title: Chicken curry with rice
recipes.excerpt: A home-style curry. Use skinless chicken to keep the fat down.
method: Brown the chicken lightly and set aside.
Cook the masala with spices until the oil separates.
Add the chicken and water, cover and simmer until cooked through.
Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Dal tadka with jeera rice
recipes.excerpt: Everyday dal with tempered spices. Pair with curd if you eat dairy.
method: Pressure-cook the dal with turmeric and salt.
Heat oil with cumin, garlic and chilli for the tadka.
Pour the tadka over the dal and simmer 5 minutes.
Serve with jeera rice.

recipes.title: Soya chunk curry with roti
recipes.excerpt: Soya chunks are one of the cheapest high-protein foods in India.
method: Boil the soya chunks for 5 minutes, then squeeze out the water.
Cook the masala with spices.
Add the chunks and a little water and simmer 10 minutes.
Serve with rotis.

recipes.title: Grilled fish with sabzi
recipes.excerpt: Light and high in protein. Works with rohu, surmai or basa.
method: Marinate the fish with lemon, turmeric, chilli and salt for 15 minutes.
Grill or pan-fry until it flakes easily.
Serve with a dry vegetable sabzi.

recipes.title: Palak paneer with roti
recipes.excerpt: Spinach and paneer. Iron, calcium and protein in one dish.
method: Blanch the spinach and blend it smooth.
Cook onion, garlic and spices, then add the spinach purée.
Add paneer cubes and simmer 5 minutes.
Serve with rotis.

recipes.title: Egg bhurji with roti
recipes.excerpt: Spiced scrambled eggs. Fast, cheap and filling.
method: Sauté onion, chilli and tomato with spices.
Add the beaten eggs and stir until just set.
Serve with rotis.

recipes.title: Roasted chana
recipes.excerpt: A crunchy, portable snack. Keep a box at work.
method: Toss the chana with chaat masala and a squeeze of lemon.

recipes.title: Sprouts chaat
recipes.excerpt: Fresh, tangy and full of fibre.
method: Steam the sprouts for 5 minutes and cool.
Mix with the vegetables, lemon and chaat masala.

recipes.title: Hung curd with fruit
recipes.excerpt: Thick, creamy and high in protein. Make hung curd by straining curd overnight.
method: Spoon the hung curd into a bowl.
Top with chopped fruit and a little honey.

recipes.title: Boiled eggs with pepper
recipes.excerpt: The simplest protein snack there is.
method: Boil the eggs for 9 to 10 minutes.
Cool in water, peel and season.
